Content: Tree; the same in every census
Stem number within its tree (1, 2, …); treeID and stemID together identify a stem
Field tag of the tree, with leading zeros and sign kept (e.g. 000006, -05599)
Field tag of the stem, used since 2010; earlier records may show the tag the stem received later
Species code; joins the species table
20 × 20 m quadrat, XXYY: column (gx/20) and row (gy/20)
Location of the tree, in m east of the western edge (0–1000); one value per tree
Location of the tree, in m north of the southern edge (0–500); one value per tree
Diameter as recorded, in mm, at height hom; empty when not measured
Height of measurement as recorded, in m
Date of the field record; empty without a record
Date of every row, in days since 1 January 1960: the recorded date, else the most common date of the tree, the quadrat or the census
Field codes as recorded, separated by ;
Field status as recorded: alive, broken below, dead, stem dead, missing; empty without a record
Analytical status: P, A, G or D (status codes)

Key of the record in the reconstruction, unique within its tree; the posterior samples list the measured records up to the tree's anchor census (2010 for most trees); empty for trees not reconstructed
